definitions.full: H3272. y 'at, [ יְעַט ] verb advise (so Jewish-Aramaic; Biblical Hebrew יעץ ); — Ithpa`al Perfect 3masculine plural אִתְיָעַ֫טוּ (K §§ 23, 1. Anm .; 39, 5) Dan 6:8 reciprocal took counsel with each other , followed by infinitive [ יָעֵט ] noun masculine counsellor (properly Participle active); — plural suffix יָָֽעֲטֹ֫הִי Ezra 7:14 , יָעֲט֫וֺהִי 7:15 .
